hypothesis.statement: A shape package alone is insufficient evidence that a MetaHuman solve can run, and accepting an older engine or stale handoff would create a false-ready state.
hypothesis.action: Bind preflight to the verified v4 input and immutable v002 handoff, require a parseable Unreal Engine 5.6 or newer, and keep plugin, Core Data, memory and disk checks fail-closed.
hypothesis.expectedResult: The workstation reports ready only when every local prerequisite and the exact Looking Glass Go handoff can be independently verified.

remainingBlockers: recover at least 37.24 GiB without deleting user assets
install MetaHuman Creator Core Data and required plugins
run the first real MetaHuman Identity solve and render five fixed 1440x2560 views
qualityBoundary: This milestone proves only toolchain readiness logic and input lineage. It does not improve or approve the unattractive MPFB face and does not claim a MetaHuman exists.
decision: Preserve v4 only as temporary solve input. Do not spend further polish iterations on its visible face; proceed to Identity conform after installation prerequisites are genuinely met.
